focus_areas: Feather texture realism (individual barb definition vs. smudging)
Edge sharpness between subject and background
Anatomical correctness of visible head features (comb/wattle integration)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the feathers. Real roosters have distinct, sharp feather edges. AI images often smear these into a 'painterly' mess. Also, verify if the comb and wattles look physically attached or if they seem to float/melt into the face. The cropping makes limb verification impossible, so focus heavily on the visible head and plumage quality.

The background is a blurred, sandy or dirt surface. The tail feathers are partially visible on the right, showing some grey/blue iridescence.
